title: Compare signal and artifact probability
description: You read the signal, posterior probability, and optional ground truth plots.

steps.description: You plot ecg against time on the first figure. The vertical axis shows signal amplitude.
You plot p_artifact on a separate figure. Its vertical axis represents the posterior probability of an artifact.

steps.question: When does the third figure appear?
steps.answer: It appears when labels_true exists in globals and has a value other than None.

steps.description: You plot the available ground truth mask with Artifact=1 on its vertical axis. All three plots use time for their horizontal coordinates.
